import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/src/codegen_support/runtime/io/file_get_contents.rs')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    emitter.instruction(\"call read\");                                           // read the entire file payload into the owned elephc string buffer through libc read()
    emitter.instruction(&format!(\"mov QWORD PTR [rbp - {}], rax\", bread_off));  // preserve the actual read byte count for the final elephc string result pair'''
new = '''    emitter.instruction(\"call read\");                                           // read the entire file payload into the owned elephc string buffer through libc read()
    // See the AArch64 arm: a FAILED read is not a byte count, and php answers the empty string.
    emitter.instruction(\"cmp rax, 0\");
    emitter.instruction(\"jge __rt_fgc_read_ok_x86\");
    emitter.instruction(\"xor eax, eax\");                                        // php's answer is the empty string
    emitter.label(\"__rt_fgc_read_ok_x86\");
    emitter.instruction(&format!(\"mov QWORD PTR [rbp - {}], rax\", bread_off));  // preserve the actual read byte count for the final elephc string result pair'''
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print('x86 fgc read guarded')
